reply.output_variable_reasoning: The output variable u/U is a dimensionless ratio of the streamwise velocity u to the free-stream velocity U, hence it has no physical dimensions. The input variables are: U (free-stream velocity) with dimensions of velocity, nu (kinematic viscosity) with dimensions of length squared per time, x (streamwise distance) with dimensions of length, and y (wall-normal distance) with dimensions of length. These four inputs are sufficient to form the dimensionless group u/U, which is the normalized velocity profile in the Blasius laminar boundary layer problem.
